queries.stars: SELECT main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, V, B, plx_value FROM basic JOIN allfluxes ON basic.oid = allfluxes.oidref WHERE V < 4.5 AND ra IS NOT NULL AND dec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY V
queries.landmarks: SELECT main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, otype, plx_value, id AS ident FROM basic JOIN ident ON basic.oid = ident.oidref WHERE id IN ('NAME Barnard''s star', 'NAME Galactic Center', 'M  31', 'M  42', 'M   1', 'M  45', 'NAME LMC', 'NAME SMC', '* alf CMa', '* alf Ori', '* alf Lyr', '* alf UMi', '* alf Cen')
